name: Mobile Suit Gundam 00
description: The year is 2307 A.D. Although fossil fuels have been depleted, humanity has obtained a new source of energy to replace them, in the form of a large-scale solar power generation system based on three huge orbital elevators. However, the benefits of this system are available only to a handful of major powers and their allies. In this world of never-ending conflict, a private armed organization appears, dedicated to the elimination of war through armed force. Its name is Celestial Being, and it is in possession of "Gundam" mobile suits.

videos.title: Celestial Being Character Second Season Preview
videos.overview: Included on the final DVD of the first season, a tongue-in-cheek sneak peek at the coming second season.

videos.title: Tenshitachi no Kiseki
videos.overview: A recap of the first season, from Setsuna's point of view.

videos.title: Celestial Being Character Movie Preview
videos.overview: Included on the final DVD of the second season, a tongue-in-cheek preview of Gundam 00's upcoming feature film.

videos.title: Celestial Being
videos.overview: At a testing ground, the AEU is demonstrating its new Enact mobile suit.  Suddenly, a white mobile suit descends from the sky and swiftly destroys the Enact. This intruder is the Gundam Exia, and this marks the start of Celestial Being's first mission.

videos.title: Gundam Meister
videos.overview: As the world reacts with confusion to Celestial Being's announcement, the Gundam Meisters prepare for a second mission which will clarify their intentions.

videos.title: The Changing World
videos.overview: The Union ace pilot Graham Aker confronts Setsuna as he leaves Ceylon. In Tokyo, the news reporter Kinue Crossroad begins her own investigation.

videos.title: Foreign Negotiations
videos.overview: The Human Reform League holds a memorial service for the soldiers whose lives were lost in the recent interventions, and reaffirms its opposition to Celestial Being.

videos.title: Breakaway Limit Zone
videos.overview: Princess Marina leaves Azadistan and begins a worldwide diplomatic tour to seek help for her impoverished nation.

videos.title: Seven Swords
videos.overview: Celestial Being's activities have reduced the level of conflict in the world, but there are some who do not welcome this change.

videos.title: Unrepayable Soul
videos.overview: During Celestial Being's intervention in Moralia, Setsuna has been reunited with a figure from his past. His opponent is the mercenary soldier Ali al-Saachez.

videos.title: Indiscriminate Retaliation
videos.overview: An international terror network has begun a campaign of bombing attacks in order to force Celestial Being to halt its armed interventions.

videos.title: The Dignity of a Great Nation
videos.overview: Four months have now passed since Celestial Being began its armed interventions. The initial chaos has subsided, and life goes on.

videos.title: Operation Gundam Capture
videos.overview: In Earth orbit, Sergei's mobile suit team continues its attack on the Ptolemaios and the Gundam Meisters. While Setsuna and Lockon defend their mothership, Allelujah and Tieria find themselves caught in the enemy's trap.

videos.title: Allelujah
videos.overview: In the aftermath of the orbital battle, the Human Reform League's scientists realize that one of the Gundam Meisters is actually a former test subject of their own Superhuman Institute.

videos.title: Towards the End of Doctrine
videos.overview: Although Princess Marina has secured assistance from the United Nations for her troubled homeland, the Kingdom of Azadistan is still in turmoil.

videos.title: Return of the Saint
videos.overview: Setsuna's actions have prevented a coup d'etat in the Kingdom of Azadistan, but the conservative leader Massoud Rachmadi remains missing, and the situation continues to worsen.

videos.title: Dawn of Determination
videos.overview: The three superpower blocs begin planning a massive joint military exercise which will serve as a challenge to Celestial Being.

videos.title: Broken Wings
videos.overview: The Union, Human Reform League, and AEU begin their joint military exercise in the Taklamakan Desert.

videos.title: Trinity
videos.overview: On the brink of defeat, the Gundam Meisters have been rescued by the intervention of Celestial Being's second team. Their rescuers identify themselves as Johann, Michael, and Nena Trinity, the Meisters of the mysterious Gundam Thrones.

videos.title: Throne Strikes
videos.overview: The Ptolemaios crew return to space for a rendezvous with Team Trinity. When they finally meet the new Gundam Meisters face to face, Setsuna and his comrades are disturbed by their attitude and behavior.

videos.title: Spearhead of Malice
videos.overview: Team Trinity continues its campaign of armed intervention. Unlike Setsuna and his comrades, they are targeting military facilities of all kinds and exterminating everyone on the scene, even civilians.

videos.title: Bonds
videos.overview: Having determined that Team Trinity itself is promoting conflict, Setsuna confronts the Gundam Thrones. Tieria comes to his assistance, and the two Gundam Meisters fight as a team for the first time.

videos.title: Blade of Revolution
videos.overview: A mysterious benefactor has provided the three superpower blocs with a new weapon against the Gundams. Quickly establishing a military alliance, the superpowers organize an elite fighting force under the aegis of the United Nations.

videos.title: Road to Ruin
videos.overview: The United Nations forces have deployed their new weapon, a mobile suit model known as the GN-X which is powered by a pseudo solar reactor. While Sergei Smirnov and Soma Peries lead a GN-X team in pursuit of the Gundam Thrones.

videos.title: Trans-Am
videos.overview: The United Nations reveals the existence of the GN-X to the world, and announces the launch of a Gundam elimination operation with the code name "Fallen Angels." The operation begins with the renewed pursuit of Team Trinity.

videos.title: The World Stands Still
videos.overview: Alejandro Corner and Ribbons Almark have forced their way into the heart of Veda and taken control of Celestial Being's master computer. But their actions have triggered an unexpected programmed response.

videos.title: The Never-Ending Poem
videos.overview: Despite the loss of Lockon, the Ptolemaios crew are united in their determination to keep fighting the United Nations forces. The enemy begins another assault, this time spearheaded by the Alvatore, a mobile armor operated by traitor Alejandro Corner.

videos.title: Setsuna
videos.overview: The Celestial Being mothership Ptolemaios has been destroyed, and most of the Gundams are beyond repair. Yet Setsuna continues his desperate fight against the overwhelming power of Alejandro Corner's mobile armor and the final weapon hidden within it.

videos.title: The Angels' Second Advent
videos.overview: The year is 2312 A.D, five years after the first appearance of Celestial Being, and four years after the organization was destroyed by the United Nations forces.

videos.title: Twin Drive
videos.overview: With the reappearance of Celestial Being, the A-LAWS begin gathering personnel who have experience fighting the Gundams.

videos.title: Operation Allelujah Rescue
videos.overview: The A-LAWS prepare a new trap for the reborn Celestial Being at a detention center for anti-government elements.

videos.title: A Reason to Battle
videos.overview: Setsuna and his comrades have successfully overpowered the A-LAWS and freed Allelujah and Marina from the Federation's detention center. When Marina asks them to return her to Azadistan, they set a course back to the Middle East.

videos.title: A Homeland Burns
videos.overview: Having been rescued from near defeat by the Katharon resistance group, the Ptolemaios 2 now takes refuge at a Katharon base in the Arabian desert.

videos.title: Scar
videos.overview: The Katharon base has been devastated by the A-LAWS attack. The words of a dying soldier remind Sumeragi of a traumatic incident from her past, and she passes out.

videos.title: With Reunions and Departure
videos.overview: Sumeragi has regained consciousness, and thanks to her tactical plan the Ptolemaios 2 is able to escape the battlefield. However, Allelujah's Gundam has been shot down along with Soma Peries, and his comrades cannot locate him.

videos.title: Pure Distortion
videos.overview: Tieria is shocked at the sudden appearance of his lookalike Regene Regetta. He is further disturbed by Regene's revelations about the Innovators.

videos.title: Indelible Past
videos.overview: Setsuna and Tieria are confronted by Ali al-Saachez and his new Arche Gundam. A furious Tieria tries to avenge Lockon, but is overwhelmed by the enemy's fighting strength.

videos.title: The Light of Heaven
videos.overview: The Federation's plan to forcibly reorganize the Middle East is opposed by the kingdom of Suille, the strongest of the Middle Eastern nations.

videos.title: Voice of 00
videos.overview: While Ian Vashti and his fellow Celestial Being mechanics prepare the O Raiser, a support machine for Setsuna's 00 Gundam, the A-LAWS deploy a devastating new weapon of their own.

videos.title: Waiting in Space
videos.overview: The Ptolemaios 2 attempts to make a hasty escape from the attacking A-LAWS. But the Gundam Meisters are hard-pressed by Kati Mannequin's tactics and the enemy's new mobile suits.

videos.title: Battle in Memento Mori
videos.overview: The Katharon space fleet has begun an assault on the satellite weapon Memento Mori, and is now under attack by A-LAWS mobile suits.

videos.title: A Song Is Heard
videos.overview: The Ptolemaios 2, damaged by the Innovators' attack, descends to Earth. Now separated from his comrades, Setsuna searches for the Ptolemaios 2. But instead, he finds Ali al-Saachez and his Arche Gundam waiting for him.

videos.title: Victory Song of the Resistance
videos.overview: The Ptolemaios 2 has received supplies from Katharon, and repairs are now in progress. But it cannot break through the Federation's siege without the fighting strength of the 00, and Setsuna has not yet returned to the ship.

videos.title: Prologue to Tragedy
videos.overview: The A-LAWS have abruptly retreated after receiving word of a coup d'etat within the Federation. Hoping to reunite with his comrades, Setsuna sets the 00 on a course for Africa.

videos.title: In the Midst of Scattered Light
videos.overview: A crisis is unfolding, but the Ptolemaios 2, which has not yet been fully repaired, is unable to break the deadlock. The wounded Setsuna returns to battle despite his injuries, asking Saji to help him save countless innocent lives.

videos.title: Mixed Feelings
videos.overview: Four months have passed since the "Break Pillar" incident, the near-collapse of an orbital elevator. The A-LAWS leaders receive word that Celestial Being has resumed activity after months of silence.

videos.title: Shadow of the Innovators
videos.overview: As Saji Crossroad searches for Louise Halevy amid the chaos of battle, Soma Peries hunts for Andrei Smirnov in order to avenge Sergei's death. Setsuna confronts the Innovator Hiling Care and unleashes the power of the Twin Drive.

videos.title: Anew Return
videos.overview: The Innovator Revive Revival is now a prisoner aboard the Ptolemaios 2, but he sneers at the questions of its crew, and gives them nothing but evasive replies. Suddenly, the crew receive word that crewmember Mileina Vashti has been taken hostage.

videos.title: The Door to Innovation
videos.overview: The Ptolemaios 2 has received a message containing coordinates for a point at Lagrange 5. The crew are suspicious, but Setsuna suggests they set course for this mysterious location.

videos.title: For the Future's Sake
videos.overview: The A-LAWS and Federation Forces are gathering a huge fleet to exterminate Celestial Being, and their leaders anticipate a final decisive battle.

videos.title: Flower of Life
videos.overview: The Innovator Regene Regetta finally rebels against Ribbons Almark.

videos.title: Beyond
videos.overview: As Tieria enters the enemy ship and learns shocking truths, the Ptolemaios 2 fights a defensive battle against the unrelenting enemy assault. One by one, our heroes fall. Setsuna cries out as if responding to the fading light of their lives.

videos.title: Revival
videos.overview: Setsuna begins a final decisive duel. Lyle's intentions, Allelujah's hopes, and Tieria's thoughts flow through the darkness of space. The particles from the 00 Raiser envelop the area around them.
